quest.title: Food Delivery
quest.description: Good Hunter has a delivery service in order to fulfill customers' requests, but due to its popularity, the service is heavily understaffed. Sara is looking for someone to lend a hand.
quest.rewards_formatted: Delicious Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake x1, Recipe: Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake x1

talks.objective: Talk to Sara at Good Hunter

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Welcome to Good Hunter— Oh, hello Traveler! You've come just at the right time.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Sorry, I know you must be hungry, but could you do something for me?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Miss Orlean from Springvale ordered a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>, but I hear Springvale's crawling with slimes these days...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I don't dare attempt the journey myself... Could you deliver this order to <color=#00E1FFFF>Orlean in Springvale</color> for me?

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Rest assured there'll be a hearty meal waiting for you on your return!

choices.text: I only came here to eat; I'm starving!

response.speaker: Sara
response.text: Once you've done what I ask, I'll treat you to something from the Good Hunter special menu! Much obliged.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Lively Orlean

dialogues.speaker: Lively Orlean
dialogues.text: Thanks! Ugh, these slimes are such a pain.

dialogues.speaker: Lively Orlean
dialogues.text: If I hadn't had such low blood sugar, I'd have taught them a lesson myself...

dialogues.speaker: Lively Orlean
dialogues.text: Mmm... Smells carroty and meaty... It's a shame it didn't get here sooner, I would have sent those slimes flying if I'd been fighting on a full stomach!

dialogues.speaker: Lively Orlean
dialogues.text: Can't be helped I suppose. Here's the money, take it back to Sara for me.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Lively Orlean

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! That was supposed to be for a customer... do you have no self-control!? Go get another batch from Sara now. You'd better hope she's in a good mood!

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Lively Orlean
Give the fee to Sara at the restaurant

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You're back! Did the delivery go okay?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Here, this <color=#00E1FFFF>Delicious Crab, Ham & Veggie Bake</color> is for you. It's fresh out of the oven, eat it while it's hot.
